headline.purpose: Page titles and primary view headings

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #F1F3F4); color: var(--primary-foreground, #202124); padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--text, #F1F3F4); border: 1px solid var(--border, #3C4043); padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface, #292A2D); }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Tonal elevation surface for displaying projects, repositories, and profile details.
components.html:
Repository Name

Automated portfolio generator for developers.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #292A2D); border: 1px solid var(--border, #3C4043); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #F1F3F4); margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary, #BDC1C6); margin: 0; }

components.name: Floating Input Field
components.description: Input field with animated focus ring and floating label.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 50px; background: var(--input-background, #303134); border: 1px solid var(--border, #3C4043); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--text, #F1F3F4); font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, #F1F3F4); }

narrative.overview: Portfolio Builder treats the portfolio creation workflow as a high-precision command center for developers. The visual language is dark-first, crisp, and architectural, emphasizing high-density utility, typographic structure, and refined surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian & Slate baseline with high-contrast monochrome primary typography.
Architectural lines and subtle borders (border-border) establishing hierarchy without heavy drop shadows.
Multi-theme adaptability (dark, light, lava, terminal, ocean, amoled) anchored on semantic CSS variables.
Fluid responsiveness with universal component parity across Web, iOS, and Android.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Direct hex colors, raw RGB values, or literal Tailwind colors (bg-white, text-black, #FFF) are strictly banned in component code. All surfaces, borders, and text must use semantic classes (bg-surface, border-border, text-text, text-text-muted).

rules.name: The Typographic Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Headings must use display font tokens with negative letter-spacing for tight architectural rhythm, while body text preserves neutral tracking and comfortable leading.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Avoid blurry dark drop-shadows on dark mode interfaces. Depth is communicated through tonal elevation steps (bg-background < bg-surface < bg-surface-elevated) outlined by crisp 1px borders (border-border).

dos: Do consume semantic tokens (bg-background, bg-surface, text-text, border-border) across all UI elements.
Do provide bilingual i18n keys for every user-visible string in both pt.json and en.json.
Do maintain 44x44pt minimum touch targets on mobile touch devices.
Do test every screen against all 4 main themes: Light, Dark, Lava, AMOLED.
Do isolate platform-specific APIs using .web.tsx and .native.tsx extensions.
donts: Don't hardcode hex colors, rgb values, or Tailwind literal colors (bg-white, text-black, #000, #FFF).
Don't insert hardcoded strings or untranslated literals directly into JSX.
Don't use bouncy or cartoonish easing transitions; use exponential/cubic deceleration (ease-out).
Don't use empty or placeholder tags without valid fallback sources.
